samples.source: To make a precaution message effective, you should show the consequences of the potential risks to the user.

samples.error_note: as far as possible限定映射要求，坏译变无条件必须映射；when必要偏离也不可改记录可选。
samples.reference: 当确有必要作出这些偏离时，应清楚记录，并尽可能将其映射到最接近的现有词汇模式，同时详细说明差异。

samples.source: Instances of either Etymon or Cognate can be assigned a language which is different from the language of the lexicon as a whole (this is specified in the LexiconInformation class as described in ISO 24613-1).
samples.known_incorrect: Etymon 或 Cognate 的实例可指定为一种语言。该语言不同于词典整体语言的语 言（ ISO 24613-1 所述的 LexiconInformation 类中规定这一内容）。
samples.error_note: 这里允许实例的语言不同于整部辞典的语言；“该语言不同于”将可不同写成必然不同。
samples.reference: 可为Etymon或Cognate的实例指定一种语言。这种语言可以与整部辞典的语言不同。辞典整体使用的语言由LexiconInformation类指定，见ISO 24613-1。

samples.source: For effectively supporting this use case, it may be useful to extend the annotation scheme with application-specific concepts.

samples.error_note: may be useful只表可能有助，坏译需要扩展改为必要措施。
samples.reference: 为了有效地支持该用例，为标注方案增加特定应用的概念可能有所帮助。

samples.source: The modelling of the syntactic and semantic properties of lexicons can differ considerably from lexicon to lexicon, due to different linguistic theories.

samples.source: The statement “In faceted classification systems an entry class common to all facets does not exist” should be moderated by indicating that such an entry class may be difficult to reach. samples.source: The example in Figure B.1 presents the TEI encoding of the name-value pair <part of speech, common noun>, where the name (key) "part of speech" is abbreviated as "POS", and the value "common noun" is symbolized by "NN". The entire name-value pair is encoded by means of the element <f>.
